title: Compare the memory ignore policy and memory revision files with their committed bytes under Git's line-ending normalization, so a CRLF checkout is not refused
outcome: Compare the memory ignore policy and memory revision files with their committed bytes under Git's line-ending normalization, so a CRLF checkout is not refused
acceptance: with core.autocrlf=true, a clean checkout of a committed memory-capable data folder exports and imports with --include-memories without memory_ignore_policy_uncommitted or a revision-bytes refusal, with a test under that Git configuration
